text:
Emily: FYI — partner webhook batch from this morning has repeated 'fingerprint' values across different customers, which is causing entitlement assignments to flip. Anyone seen this pattern before? @Raj @Lindsey

Raj: yep, noticed ~2% of today's events. logs show fingerprint = sha256(timestamp + device_id) on their side — pretty small entropy if timestamps are rounded. collisions possible.

Lindsey: can you paste an example payload?

Emily: sure, here's a sanitized sample we pulled from staging logs:
```json
{
  "partner_event_id": "evt_abc123",
  "fingerprint": "d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e",
  "tenant_id": "acct_42",
  "usage": 120,
  "reported_ts": "2026-03-21T09:12:00Z"
}
```

Tom: if their fingerprint uses rounded timestamps, you'll see duplicates across tenants. short-term we can: 1) treat fingerprint as advisory only, 2) dedupe by (partner_event_id, reported_ts), 3) flag mismatch for manual review. long-term ask partner to include event_uuid + strong signature.

ops-bot: Ticket created: PRJ-5021 - partner webhook fingerprint collisions (owner: Raj) :ticket:

Raj: plan proposal — backfill reconciliation using partner_event_id where available; for events missing it, use composite key (fingerprint, tenant_id, reported_ts). I'll scope ETA: triage + backfill script ~48-72h. Need partner to confirm whether partner_event_id is guaranteed unique across their infra.

Lindsey: I'll add an alert: metric 'partner_webhook_fingerprint_collision_rate' and a dashboard. If rate > 0.1% for >1h, page oncall. I'll also draft a short runbook and attach to the ticket.

Emily: action items noted: Raj -> partner coordination + backfill plan; Lindsey -> metrics + runbook; Tom -> implement advisory-dedupe middleware and route 'suspicious' to manual queue; I'll update partner channel once we have next steps.

Tom: pushing a small middleware patch to staging now. If a fingerprint is present but tenant_id differs from existing record, we mark event as 'suspicious' and do not auto-credit. Will open PR and link.

si-pm: Investigating on partner side. Looks like a client lib bug that drops unique id when clock skew/rounding happens. We'll push a fix to their emitter in 24h and provide a signed event_uuid field.

Emily: great — keep me posted. Also, Raj, can you ask partner to provide a sample of their hashing code? that will help validate our reconciliation. :thumbsup:

Raj: will request now, pinging partner oncall.

Lindsey: runbook draft uploaded to the ticket (link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/PRJ-5021). set up grafana panel + alert.

ops-bot: Backfill job scheduled: PRJ-5021-BACKFILL, window: 2026-03-21T00:00Z -> 2026-03-21T12:00Z, owner: Raj

Emily: thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single source of truth. I'll post a short partner-facing summary after we confirm their fix.

Tom: PR link: https://git.redwood/integrations/pulls/1287 (staging).

si-pm: Partner confirms patch deployed to staging, will monitor collisions for next 6 hours.

Emily: perfect. closing loop here once collision rate drops and backfill completes.
